hypotheses.expected: No known high-confidence evaluator blind spot should prevent measuring the bounded production controls planned next.
hypotheses.actual: Deterministic fixtures and all four V3.1 transitions work; live actor/legal omissions, proposed IP corruption and unsupported SSH are measurable. Review identifies no high-confidence missed within-key defect preventing the bounded comparison. Two lexical false positives and one moderate support-scope miss remain documented; finite scope is explicit.
hypotheses.explanation: Suitability is limited to the declared subject aliases, fields, numeric/protocol vocabularies and comparison claims. Ordinary residual ambiguity does not justify V3.3. No scientific blocking defect is known, but review is not independent human adjudication or universal coverage proof.
